notes: New — Entries (નોંધ): when you fetch an Integrated survey record, the app now also captures the scanned handwritten mutation entries (shown in red on the government site). Open them from the new નોંધ / Entries button on the Integrated card — view, colour-mark, or share any of them. The red entry numbers also print bold in the survey PDF so they show on a black-and-white print. Also: a survey number already in a village won't be added twice, and Back now needs a double-press to leave a fetch (a stray tap won't interrupt it). Your saved records are kept.
